en.headline: Competition Commission mounts second-round raids in building maintenance bid-rigging probe
en.dek: Officers searched 12 premises including four contractors’ offices and residences over suspected cartel conduct affecting 28 estates and buildings with contracts worth about HK$500 million.
body: The Competition Commission said it conducted a second round of enforcement action under Operation Hunter on Wednesday, searching 12 premises across Hong Kong under court warrants. The premises included the offices of four engineering contractors and the residences of individuals involved.

The Commission said the action followed analysis of evidence from an earlier January operation that uncovered a suspicious telephone conversation pointing to another hidden bid-rigging group. One previously uninvestigated contractor is suspected of distributing pricing instructions, known as “homework”, to other contractors to manipulate tender outcomes, and of arranging cover bids through intermediaries.

The suspected conduct, involving bid-rigging, market sharing, price fixing and the exchange of sensitive information, is alleged to breach the First Conduct Rule of the Competition Ordinance. The 28 building-maintenance projects span 12 districts; some contracts remain unawarded while others had already started or finished before the investigation began.

The Commission said it has been contacting stakeholders of the affected buildings and is exercising its compulsory powers to require documents and attendance for interviews. It declined to name the parties while the investigation continues.

zh.headline: 競委會樓宇維修圍標案第二輪執法 涉28屋苑約5億元
zh.dek: 競委會周三根據法庭手令搜查12個處所，包括4間工程承辦商辦公室及涉案人士住所，懷疑違反《競爭條例》第一行為守則。
body: 競爭事務委員會表示，周三展開代號「獵人」第二輪執法行動，根據法庭手令搜查全港12個處所，包括4間工程承辦商的辦公地點及涉案人士住所。
競委會指，行動源於今年1月首輪搜查後深入分析證據，發現一段可疑電話訊息對話，顯示另有潛藏圍標集團。其中一間先前未被調查的承辦商，涉嫌在屋苑維修工程招標期間透過中間人物色其他承辦商提交掩護式標書，並向其他承辦商分發俗稱「功課」的入標價格指示，操控投標結果。
有關行為涉嫌構成圍標、瓜分市場、合謀定價及交換敏感資料，違反《競爭條例》下的「第一行為守則」。涉案28個維修工程項目分布港九新界12個地區，初步估計合約總值約5億港元；部分合約仍未批出，部分則在調查展開前已開展或完成。
競委會表示已陸續聯絡涉案樓宇的相關持份者，並行使條例賦予的強制權力要求有關各方提交文件及出席聆訊。現階段不便公開調查對象，待完成調查後若採取進一步行動會適時公布。
